about.sectionTitle: Engineering systems that carry real financial weight and autonomous intelligence.
paragraphs: I am a Full-Stack Engineer specializing in banking and financial systems across Go, React, and Android. My production work spans critical financial infrastructure: Go services on BRILink Mobile (Brimola ecommerce for PSO/NPSO and webview integrations), service contracts and Kafka event architectures across BRiSpot/BNS, and enterprise cash management on BRI QLola/QCash (microfrontend migration with Module Federation and high-throughput payroll workflows).

Alongside banking systems, I architect autonomous intelligence. I created Methora (Universal Autonomous Operating Intelligence) — an open-domain autonomous orchestrator connecting a multi-node Mac mesh (Pro & Air), Grok Bot VM (cursor), and mobile (Paseo). My day-to-day workflow integrates Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, MCP, Graphify, and OmniRoute with deep focus on prompt, context, and harness engineering.

Full-stack stays. Autonomous orchestration and agent engineering are how I build and move faster; they do not replace the engineering stack. Practical engineering on my own machines, grounded in shipping reliable production systems.

selectedWork.title: QLola / QCash
selectedWork.description: Frontend-heavy work on an enterprise cash-management surface: microfrontend migration with Module Federation, responsive dashboards, payroll transfer and mass transfer workflows with secure file handling.

selectedWork.title: BRI BRILink + BRiSpot/BNS
selectedWork.description: BRILink Mobile (Apr 2026–present): Go services for Brimola ecommerce (PSO and NPSO) and other BRILink backends such as webview integrations. NPSO is a Brimola product type, not another name for BRILink. Before that, BRiSpot/BNS (Jan–Mar 2026): protobuf contracts, Kafka event paths, and CISO-facing integration changes across the BNS ecosystem.

selectedWork.title: Kreditplus
selectedWork.description: Finance backend at SIGMATECH / Kreditplus, July 2025 to January 2026 — not a 2026 job. Database migration toward PostgreSQL, backward-compatible APIs, observability, and test coverage on account and transaction flows.

selectedWork.description: Open-domain autonomous orchestrator connecting multi-node Mac mesh (Pro & Air), Grok Bot VM (cursor), and mobile (Paseo). Harness and agent engineering integrating Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, MCP, Graphify, and OmniRoute.

philosophy.sectionTitle: The best systems stop asking for attention.
philosophy.body: I care less about flashy software and more about systems that become trustworthy, calm, and almost invisible. The best technology does not demand constant attention. It carries complexity quietly.

contact.cta: If you need complete product delivery across banking backends, web, or mobile, with autonomous intelligence and agent workflows that stay accountable to the engineer, I am interested in problems that need one person to own the path from architecture to delivery.
